name: SignFi
summary: Fine-grained sign-language recognition dataset collected from WiFi CSI in laboratory and home environments.

settings.scenario: 276 sign-language gestures in lab and home settings

standardization.notes: Authorized local copy required. WiSenseHub can process it locally, but cannot host CSI or publish previews. The source is [200 time, 30 subcarriers, 3 Rx, samples]; each local output is [T, S, 1 Tx, 3 Rx]. The source packet rate is not reported, so any 100 Hz task view is recorded as a target-grid assumption.
